title: IN-PLACE MATERIAL, COMPONENT PROPERTIES AND ARCHAIC STRUCTURAL
officialText:
SYSTEMS
707.1 General. Methods of design and properties of in-place structural materials, components,
and assemblies, including archaic structural systems, shall be determined according to Appendix
H or other requirements specified in this code.
